title: Exact event-count coboundary converts a stopped Foster deficit to time currency
statement: For the stated C3 ports/core,ell=3(A+D)-4(C+F) gives pathwise Jnc(t)=4N0(t)+ell(x)-ell(X_t),and Lell=4B0-qnc. For integrable actual stops,the full Foster deficit E[T+Jnc(T)+W(X_T)]-W(x) equals E[(1+4B0)T+(W-ell)(X_T)]-(W-ell)(x). This is exact accounting,not a sign assertion. More generally J=mN0+w(x)-w(X_t) when an actual covector has increments m-1 on the constant source,-1 on the other circuit reactions,and0 on core.
